name: Clipboard Image
description: Reads images from the Windows clipboard via a PowerShell helper so TPM can pass user screenshots to the multimodal Read tool for visual analysis.

scriptPath.label: Script Path
scriptPath.description: Path to the PowerShell helper that reads the clipboard image to a temp file. Defaults to the bundled script; resolved relative to repo root if not absolute. Must print the temp file's absolute path as its only stdout line.

tempFileDir.label: Temp File Directory
tempFileDir.description: Directory the helper writes clipboard images into. Empty uses the OS default temp directory (%TEMP% on Windows, /tmp on WSL).

autoReadOnTriggerPhrase.label: Auto-Read On Trigger Phrase
autoReadOnTriggerPhrase.description: When on, TPM auto-runs the clipboard helper when the user says a Trigger Phrase. When off, it only runs on explicit request.

triggerPhrases.label: Trigger Phrases
triggerPhrases.description: Comma-separated, case-insensitive substrings that auto-trigger the clipboard helper. No effect when Auto-Read On Trigger Phrase is off.
triggerPhrases.default: look at my clipboard, check my clipboard, check this screenshot, see my clipboard, here is a screenshot, paste my screenshot, image in my clipboard

includePathInSweAssignments.label: Include Path In SWE Assignments
includePathInSweAssignments.description: When on, TPM includes the clipboard image's absolute path in SWE assignments it informs, so SWE can re-read it. When off, TPM describes it in prose only.
